query:
SELECT id, title, 
  LEFT(wavUrl, 80) as wavUrl_sample,
  LEFT(mp3PreviewUrl, 80) as mp3PreviewUrl_sample,
  watermarkStatus
FROM tracks 
LIMIT 5;
